name: marketingskills
description: A collection of marketing-related capabilities designed for Claude Code and AI agents focusing on conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.

inputs.name: marketing_data
inputs.description: Raw or processed marketing content, campaign data, or analytics reports to be analyzed or optimized.

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.description: SEO keywords or phrases relevant to the targeted marketing content or campaign.

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Description or profile of the intended audience for marketing efforts.

inputs.name: performance_metrics
inputs.description: Analytics and performance data related to marketing campaigns used for optimization.

inputs.name: copy_draft
inputs.description: Draft marketing text or copy for copywriting enhancement.

outputs.name: optimized_copy
outputs.description: Enhanced marketing text that improves engagement and conversion rates.

outputs.name: seo_recommendations
outputs.description: Suggestions and best practices for SEO improvements.

outputs.name: conversion_insights
outputs.description: Insights and actionable recommendations for improving conversion rates based on analytics.

outputs.name: growth_strategies
outputs.description: Recommended growth hacking or engineering tactics tailored to marketing goals.

steps: Gather input marketing data, audience profiling, and performance metrics
Analyze existing copy and SEO data for weaknesses and opportunities
Generate optimized copy and SEO recommendations using AI
Iterate refinements and test growth engineering tactics
Deploy optimized marketing content and track results for continuous improvement
use_cases: Improving website landing page conversion rates
Generating high-quality copywriting for email campaigns
Optimizing web content for search engine rankings
Analyzing marketing analytics to identify growth opportunities
Scaling marketing efforts through automated AI-assisted strategies
patterns: Iterative copywriting refinement for higher conversion
SEO keyword integration and content structuring
Growth engineering through experimentation and metrics tracking
Collaborative prompt-driven workflows for AI-assisted marketing

prompt_templates.name: optimize_copywriting
prompt_templates.template: Improve this marketing copy for better conversion and engagement: {copy_draft}

prompt_templates.name: seo_analysis
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following content and provide SEO keyword recommendations: {marketing_data}

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Given these performance metrics {performance_metrics}, suggest improvements to increase conversion rates.

prompt_templates.name: growth_strategy_generation
prompt_templates.template: Generate growth engineering strategies tailored for {target_audience} to enhance marketing reach.
